Silver Chains & Black Blazer
Rights check

WORKING NOTES
- The layered silver chains and blue backdrop create the
mood.
- Add 'dramatic side lighting' to sharpen the shadows.
Try this: Add dramatic side lighting.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a high,
sleek black ponytail wears a black blazer
over a sheer black lace bralette. She
has layered silver chain necklaces, a
small silver hoop earring, and bold red
lips. Her gaze is directed down and to
the side. A deep blue studio backdrop
with soft directional light. Palette of
cobalt, black, and silver. Sharp and
moody, in the style of a cool-toned
fashion editorial.
